subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Hexacyanoferrate(III)（[Fe(CN)₆]³⁻）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Trigonal planar
D. Trigonal bipyramidal
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Fe (group 8) 8 e; 6 × CN (X) 6 e; the 3− charge adds 3 e: 17 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −6 in all and the complex has a 3− charge, so the metal is Fe(III), d⁵; d⁵ + 12 e from the ligands = 17 e. Ferricyanide.
